title: Skip stateDiff serialization while no opted-in /api/events connection is subscribed
outcome: Skip stateDiff serialization while no opted-in /api/events connection is subscribed
acceptance: The state broadcaster counts opted-in (stateDiff=1) /api/events connections the same way it counts legacy ones: registered before subscribe, and released by a guard that owns the stream's lifetime. It skips stateDiff serialization while that count is zero, without breaking base alignment for the first opted-in client to arrive. A deterministic test shows that, with only legacy subscribers, each cut serializes only the full state.
